head_commit.message: Koerner (FantasyLabs) projections, Sun Nov 1 2026 8:05 AM PT

Fix daylight-time break: real Pacific/Eastern zones everywhere, schedules back to their Pacific times

Clocks fell back Nov 1; ~25 files hard-coded Pacific as UTC-7, so every PT stamp read an hour late and the
system check called the Scout and Radar stale (6 red). GitHub schedules also fired an hour early in Pacific.
